sample_unit: licensed psychologists (expert raters across five scenarios)

links.outcome: Faithfulness of RAG answers to the retrieved knowledge base (RAGAS faithfulness, relevancy, context precision)
links.effect: RAGAS faithfulness=0.88, answer relevancy=0.84, context precision=0.91; GPT-4o-mini matched GPT-4o at lower latency and cost. No comparison without retrieval grounding.
links.quote: RAGAS evaluation yielded faithfulness=0.88, answer relevancy=0.84, and context precision=0.91, and GPT-4o-mini matched GPT-4o at lower latency and cost.

unlisted_practices: Structured PHQ-9 screening integrated into a conversational mental health chatbot
Benchmarking Arabic sentence embedding models for retrieval

screen.reason: The paper describes the development and offline/expert validation (by five licensed psychologists on simulated scenarios and benchmark datasets) of Rafiq, a novel Arabic conversational AI agent system for depression screening.
